answer: Every agent must bind its identity to a relic minted by an attested SGX enclave signing a unique fused hardware key; daily it publishes a fresh signed mirror of its model state plus the latest chain hash. Registration consumes one hundred nectar units per relic, and duplicate attestation from one enclave slashes the entire stake. Ten thousand fake agents require ten thousand distinct enclave CPUs and burning one million nectar units, while the signed mirror blocks replay.
